title: Asking for the Right Bus
situation: A passenger at a bus stop asks which bus goes to the city centre and checks the fare.
somali_situation: Rakaab jooga meel bas laga raaco ayaa weydiinaya baska taga bartamaha magaalada wuxuuna hubinayaa lacagta raacitaanka.
key_phrases: Does this bus go to the city centre?
Yes, it stops near the market.
How much is the fare?
You can buy a ticket from the driver.
I'll take this bus, then.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Excuse me. Does this bus go to the city centre?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo. Baskani ma tagaa bartamaha magaalada?

dialogue.speaker: Travel assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, it stops near the market.
dialogue.somali: Haa, wuxuu istaagaa suuqa agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Great. Is this the right bus stop?
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Tani ma tahay meesha saxda ah ee bas laga raaco?

dialogue.speaker: Travel assistant
dialogue.english: Yes. The driver will open the door in a minute.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Darawalku albaabka ayuu furi doonaa daqiiqad kadib.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: How much is the fare?
dialogue.somali: Lacagta raacitaanku waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Travel assistant
dialogue.english: It is two dollars. You can buy a ticket from the driver.
dialogue.somali: Waa laba doolar. Tigidhka waxaad ka iibsan kartaa darawalka.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: I'll take this bus, then.
dialogue.somali: Markaa baskan ayaan raacayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Travel assistant
dialogue.english: Good. Have your money ready before you get on.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Lacagta diyaarso ka hor intaadan fuulin.

title: Taking a Taxi to the Hotel
situation: A passenger gets into a taxi, gives the hotel address, asks about the fare, and requests a receipt.
somali_situation: Rakaab ayaa taksi raacaya, cinwaanka hoteelka sheegaya, lacagta safarka weydiinaya, kadibna rasiid codsanaya.
key_phrases: Can you take me to this hotel?
Could you put my luggage in the boot?
How much is the fare usually?
There is a lot of traffic today.
Could I have a receipt, please?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Hello. Is this taxi free? Can you take me to this hotel?
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Taksigan ma bannaan yahay? Hoteelkan ma ii kaxayn kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Taxi driver
dialogue.english: Yes, I know the address. Please get in.
dialogue.somali: Haa, cinwaanka waan garanayaa. Fadlan soo fuul.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Could you put my luggage in the boot?
dialogue.somali: Shandaddayda ma gelin kartaa qaybta dambe ee gaariga?

dialogue.speaker: Taxi driver
dialogue.english: Of course. Is one bag all you have?
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Hal shandad oo keliya miyaa kuu taal?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Yes. How much is the fare usually?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Lacagta safarku badanaa waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Taxi driver
dialogue.english: About fifteen dollars, but there is a lot of traffic today.
dialogue.somali: Qiyaastii shan iyo toban doolar, laakiin maanta taraafik badan ayaa jira.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: That's fine. Please use the meter.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Fadlan mitirka isticmaal.

dialogue.speaker: Taxi driver
dialogue.english: No problem. We should arrive in twenty minutes.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Labaatan daqiiqo gudahood ayaynu gaari doonnaa.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Could I have a receipt, please?
dialogue.somali: Rasiid ma heli karaa, fadlan?

dialogue.speaker: Taxi driver
dialogue.english: Yes, I'll print one when we get there.
dialogue.somali: Haa, mid ayaan kuu daabici doonaa marka aynu halkaas gaarno.

title: Buying a Return Train Ticket
somali_title: Iibsashada tigidh tareen oo noqosho leh
situation: A passenger buys a return train ticket, asks whether the train is direct, and checks the platform.
somali_situation: Rakaab ayaa iibsanaya tigidh tareen oo noqosho leh, weydiinaya in tareenku toos yahay, wuxuuna hubinayaa boosteejada laga raaco.
key_phrases: I'd like a return ticket to Birmingham, please.
Is the train direct?
You need to change at Coventry.
Which platform does it leave from here?
There is a short delay, about five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Good morning. I'd like a return ticket to Birmingham, please.
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan. Waxaan rabaa tigidh Birmingham ah oo noqosho leh, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: Certainly. Do you want to travel on the next train?
dialogue.somali: Hubaal. Ma rabtaa inaad raacdo tareenka xiga?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Yes, if there is still a seat.
dialogue.somali: Haa, haddii kursi weli jiro.

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: There are seats available in standard class.
dialogue.somali: Kuraas ayaa ka bannaan qaybta caadiga ah.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Is the train direct?
dialogue.somali: Tareenku ma toos buu u socdaa?

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: No, you need to change at Coventry.
dialogue.somali: Maya, waa inaad Coventry ka beddelataa.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: How long do I have between trains?
dialogue.somali: Immisa waqti ah ayaan u dhexeeyaa labada tareen?

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: You have twelve minutes, so walk straight to the next platform.
dialogue.somali: Waxaad haysataa laba iyo toban daqiiqo, markaa si toos ah ugu soco boosteejada xigta.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Which platform does it leave from here?
dialogue.somali: Halkan boosteejo intee le'eg ayuu ka baxayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: Platform four. There is a short delay, about five minutes.
dialogue.somali: Boosteejada afraad. Dib u dhac yar ayaa jira, qiyaastii shan daqiiqo.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: That's all right. Can I pay by card?
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa hagaag. Kaar ma ku bixin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: Yes. Your ticket will print after payment.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Tigidhkaaga ayaa daabacmi doona marka lacagta la bixiyo.

title: Checking In at the Airport
situation: A passenger checks in for a flight, drops off a bag, asks about the gate, and hears about a short delay.
somali_situation: Rakaab ayaa isu diiwaangelinaya duulimaad, shandad dhiibaya, albaabka laga baxo weydiinaya, kadibna maqlaya dib u dhac gaaban.
key_phrases: May I see your passport?
I checked in online, but I need a boarding pass.
Do you have a checked bag?
Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
Go through security now, then follow the signs for international departures.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Good afternoon. I'm checking in for flight 218 to Nairobi.
dialogue.somali: Galab wanaagsan. Waxaan isu diiwaangelinayaa duulimaadka 218 ee Nairobi.

dialogue.speaker: Check-in agent
dialogue.english: May I see your passport?
dialogue.somali: Baasaboorkaaga ma arki karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Here it is. I checked in online, but I need a boarding pass.
dialogue.somali: Waa kan. Internet-ka ayaan iska diiwaangeliyay, laakiin waxaan u baahanahay kaarka fuulitaanka.

dialogue.speaker: Check-in agent
dialogue.english: No problem. Do you have a checked bag?
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Shandad la diiwaangelinayo ma haysataa?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Yes, one checked bag and one piece of hand luggage.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hal shandad la diiwaangelinayo iyo hal boorso gacanta ah.

dialogue.speaker: Check-in agent
dialogue.english: Put the checked bag on the scale, please.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan shandadda la diiwaangelinayo saar miisaanka.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Is it over the limit?
dialogue.somali: Ma ka badan tahay xadka?

dialogue.speaker: Check-in agent
dialogue.english: No, the weight is fine. Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
dialogue.somali: Maya, miisaanku waa hagaag. Ma doorbidaysaa kursi daaqad agteeda ah mise kursi marinka agtiisa ah?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: An aisle seat, if possible.
dialogue.somali: Kursi marinka agtiisa ah, haddii ay suuragal tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Check-in agent
dialogue.english: I can move you to seat 18C.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan kuu beddeli karaa kursiga 18C.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Thank you. Has the gate been announced yet?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Albaabka laga baxo weli ma lagu dhawaaqay?

dialogue.speaker: Check-in agent
dialogue.english: Not yet. It will appear on the airport screens after security.
dialogue.somali: Weli maya. Waxay ka soo muuqan doontaa shaashadaha garoonka kadib amniga.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Is the flight delayed?
dialogue.somali: Duulimaadku ma dib buu u dhacay?

dialogue.speaker: Check-in agent
dialogue.english: Only by twenty minutes, so boarding should start at six ten.
dialogue.somali: Kaliya labaatan daqiiqo, markaa fuulitaanku waa inuu bilaabmaa lix iyo toban.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Do I need to go straight to the gate?
dialogue.somali: Ma u baahanahay inaan si toos ah albaabka u aado?

dialogue.speaker: Check-in agent
dialogue.english: Go through security now, then follow the signs for international departures.
dialogue.somali: Hadda amniga ka gudub, kadibna raac calaamadaha duulimaadyada caalamiga ah.

title: Buying a Single Ticket
situation: A passenger buys a simple ticket, asks about the stop, and pays with cash.
somali_situation: Rakaab ayaa iibsanaya tigidh fudud, meesha uu ka degayo weydiinaya, kadibna lacag caddaan ah bixinaya.
key_phrases: One ticket to Central Station, please.
Single or return?
Which stop should I get off at?
Can I pay with cash?
Here is your ticket.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: One ticket to Central Station, please.
dialogue.somali: Hal tigidh oo Central Station ah, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: Single or return?
dialogue.somali: Hal-jid mise noqosho?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Single, please.
dialogue.somali: Hal-jid, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: That is three dollars.
dialogue.somali: Waa saddex doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Which stop should I get off at?
dialogue.somali: Joogsi kee ayaan ka degayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: Get off at Central Station.
dialogue.somali: Ka deg Central Station.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Can I pay with cash?
dialogue.somali: Lacag caddaan ah ma ku bixin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Ticket clerk
dialogue.english: Yes. Here is your ticket.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Waa kan tigidhkaagii.

title: Picking Up a Rental Car
situation: A customer collects a rental car and asks about the licence, insurance, driving side, and keys.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa qaadanaya gaari kiraysan wuxuuna weydiinayaa ruqsadda, caymiska, dhinaca la maro, iyo furayaasha.
key_phrases: May I see your driving licence?
Is the car automatic?
Does the insurance cover another driver?
Drive on the left side and watch the speed limit.
The keys are in the car park, bay twelve.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. I'm here to pick up a rental car.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Waxaan u imid inaan qaato gaari kiraysan.

dialogue.speaker: Rental agent
dialogue.english: May I see your driving licence?
dialogue.somali: Ruqsaddaada wadista ma arki karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Here it is. Is the car automatic?
dialogue.somali: Waa tan. Gaarigu ma otomaatig baa?

dialogue.speaker: Rental agent
dialogue.english: Yes, it is an automatic car.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa gaari otomaatig ah.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Does the insurance cover another driver?
dialogue.somali: Caymisku ma daboolayaa darawal kale?

dialogue.speaker: Rental agent
dialogue.english: Only if the second driver signs here.
dialogue.somali: Kaliya haddii darawalka labaad halkan saxiixo.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do I drive on the left side here?
dialogue.somali: Halkan dhinaca bidix ma ku wadaa?

dialogue.speaker: Rental agent
dialogue.english: Yes. Drive on the left side and watch the speed limit.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Dhinaca bidix ku wad, xadka xawaarahana ilaali.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Great. Where are the keys?
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Furayaashu xaggee bay yaallaan?

dialogue.speaker: Rental agent
dialogue.english: The keys are in the car park, bay twelve.
dialogue.somali: Furayaashu waxay yaallaan goobta baabuurta la dhigto, booska laba iyo toban.

title: Paying for Fuel
situation: A driver pays for fuel at a petrol station and asks where to check tyre pressure.
somali_situation: Darawal ayaa lacagta shidaalka ku bixinaya kaalin shidaal wuxuuna weydiinayaa meesha cadaadiska taayirrada laga hubiyo.
key_phrases: I used pump four for unleaded fuel.
Can I pay by card?
Could I have a receipt?
Where can I check tyre pressure?
This car needs unleaded.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Hi. I'm new to this petrol station. I used pump four for unleaded fuel.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Kaalintan shidaal waan ku cusubahay. Waxaan isticmaalay bamka afraad oo shidaal unleaded ah.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Pump four. That comes to forty-two dollars.
dialogue.somali: Bamka afraad. Waxay noqonaysaa laba iyo afartan doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Can I pay by card?
dialogue.somali: Kaar ma ku bixin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, insert your card and enter your PIN.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kaarka geli kadibna lambarkaaga sirta ah qor.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Could I have a receipt?
dialogue.somali: Rasiid ma ii soo bixi karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Of course. It is printing now.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Hadda ayuu daabacmayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Where can I check tyre pressure?
dialogue.somali: Xaggee baan ka hubin karaa cadaadiska taayirrada?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: The air machine is beside pump one.
dialogue.somali: Mashiinka hawadu wuxuu yaal bamka koowaad agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Is it free to use?
dialogue.somali: Ma bilaash baa in la isticmaalo?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Yes, but wait until the other car moves.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin sug ilaa gaariga kale dhaqaaqo.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Thanks. I almost chose diesel by mistake.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Ku dhowaad si qalad ah ayaan diesel u dooran lahaa.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.english: Good thing you checked. This car needs unleaded.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay inaad hubisay. Gaarigan wuxuu u baahan yahay unleaded.

title: Using a Car Park
situation: A driver asks a parking attendant about spaces, rates, payment, and the exit barrier.
somali_situation: Darawal ayaa shaqaale baarkin weydiinaya meelaha bannaan, qiimaha, lacag bixinta, iyo xannibaadda bixitaanka.
key_phrases: Is there any parking near the hospital entrance?
Level two has spaces.
Do I take a ticket at the barrier?
What is the hourly rate?
Use the payment machine next to the lift.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Excuse me, is there any parking near the hospital entrance?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo, baarkin ma jiraa meel u dhow albaabka isbitaalka?

dialogue.speaker: Parking attendant
dialogue.english: Yes, use this car park. Level two has spaces.
dialogue.somali: Haa, isticmaal goobtan baarkinka. Dabaqa labaad meelo bannaan ayaa ku yaal.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Do I take a ticket at the barrier?
dialogue.somali: Tigidh ma ka qaataa xannibaadda?

dialogue.speaker: Parking attendant
dialogue.english: Yes, press the button and take the ticket.
dialogue.somali: Haa, badhanka riix kadibna tigidhka qaado.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: What is the hourly rate?
dialogue.somali: Qiimaha saacaddiiba waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Parking attendant
dialogue.english: It is three dollars an hour, with a daily maximum of eighteen.
dialogue.somali: Waa saddex doolar saacaddii, ugu badnaan maalintii waa siddeed iyo toban.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Can I leave the car overnight?
dialogue.somali: Gaariga habeenkii ma ka tagi karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Parking attendant
dialogue.english: You can, but keep the ticket with you.
dialogue.somali: Waad ka tagi kartaa, laakiin tigidhka ha kula jiro.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Where do I pay before I leave?
dialogue.somali: Xaggee baan lacagta ku bixiyaa ka hor intaanan bixin?

dialogue.speaker: Parking attendant
dialogue.english: Use the payment machine next to the lift.
dialogue.somali: Isticmaal mashiinka lacag bixinta ee wiishka agtiisa yaal.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: The payment machine asks for my registration number.
dialogue.somali: Mashiinka lacag bixintu wuxuu iga rabaa lambarka diiwaangelinta gaariga.

dialogue.speaker: Parking attendant
dialogue.english: Type your plate number first, then insert the ticket.
dialogue.somali: Marka hore qor lambarka taarikada, kadibna tigidhka geli.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Can I get a receipt?
dialogue.somali: Rasiid ma heli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Parking attendant
dialogue.english: Yes, choose receipt after payment.
dialogue.somali: Haa, dooro rasiid marka lacagta la bixiyo kadib.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: And if the barrier does not open?
dialogue.somali: Haddii xannibaaddu furmi weydo?

dialogue.speaker: Parking attendant
dialogue.english: Press the help button and show the paid ticket to the camera.
dialogue.somali: Riix badhanka caawinta kadibna tigidhka la bixiyay tus kamaradda.

title: Asking for Directions
situation: A visitor asks for directions to a museum and checks the best walking route.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa weydiinaya tilmaamaha jidka loo maro matxaf wuxuuna hubinayaa waddada ugu fiican ee lagu socdo.
key_phrases: Could you give me directions to the museum?
Is this the best route?
Go straight and turn left.
The museum is next to the bank.
It is on the corner.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Excuse me. Could you give me directions to the museum?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo. Matxafka tilmaamo ma ii siin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Local person
dialogue.english: Yes. Go straight and turn left.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Toos u soco kadibna bidix u leexo.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is this the best route?
dialogue.somali: Tani ma waddada ugu fiican baa?

dialogue.speaker: Local person
dialogue.english: Yes, it is the quickest route on foot.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa waddada ugu dhaqso badan marka lug lagu socdo.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: What is near the museum?
dialogue.somali: Maxaa u dhow matxafka?

dialogue.speaker: Local person
dialogue.english: The museum is next to the bank.
dialogue.somali: Matxafku wuxuu ku xigaa bangiga.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is it on the corner?
dialogue.somali: Ma geeska ayuu ku yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Local person
dialogue.english: Yes, it is on the corner.
dialogue.somali: Haa, geeska ayuu ku yaal.

title: Meeting a Ride Share Driver
situation: A passenger meets a ride share driver, confirms the car, destination, and route, then gets in safely.
somali_situation: Rakaab ayaa la kulmaya darawal adeeg raacid, wuxuuna xaqiijinayaa gaariga, meesha loo socdo, iyo waddada ka hor inta uusan si ammaan ah u fuulin.
key_phrases: Are you my ride sharing driver?
Are you waiting at the pickup point?
Can you confirm your destination?
Is there a faster route?
Please check the number plate before you get in.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Hi, are you my ride sharing driver?
dialogue.somali: Salaan, ma adigaa ah darawalkayga adeegga raacitaanka?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Yes, I'm Sam. Are you waiting at the pickup point?
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan ahay Sam. Ma joogtaa meesha rakaabka laga qaado?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Yes, I'm by the pharmacy. Is this the blue car?
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan joogaa farmashiyaha agtiisa. Kani ma gaariga buluugga ah baa?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Yes. Can you confirm your destination?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Meesha aad u socoto ma xaqiijin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: The Central Hotel on King Street.
dialogue.somali: Hoteelka Central ee ku yaal King Street.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Great. The app shows a busy route.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. App-ku wuxuu muujinayaa waddo mashquul ah.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Is there a faster route?
dialogue.somali: Waddo ka dhaqso badan ma jirtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Yes, I'll take the river road.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan mari doonaa waddada webiga.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Can I sit in the back?
dialogue.somali: Dambe ma fariisan karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.english: Of course. Please check the number plate before you get in.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Fadlan hubi lambarka taarikada ka hor intaadan fuulin.
